source_title: Bandhan Bank reports ₹622 cr net profit in Q2, gross NPA at 3.11% - Business Standard
source_excerpt:
Bandhan Bank reported a net profit of ₹622 crore in Q2 FY27, with gross NPAs at 3.11%, interest earned at ₹5,754 crore and provisions at ₹718 crore.
Bandhan Bank reported a net profit of ₹622 crore for the September quarter, with gross non-performing assets at 3.11% and provisions at ₹718 crore.
